text: {"lessons":["My account is above its starting value, but the ups and downs—including a 3.4% monthly decline—show that gains so far do not remove risk.","My sales have included both gains and a loss; a trade’s result against my purchase cost alone does not show whether it was the right choice for my retirement needs.","I should avoid reacting to short-term movements and make measured decisions that preserve flexibility and limit risk, rather than trading frequently without a clear reason."]}
